caption: The drawing depicts a grid-like composition divided into sixteen rectangular sections on a pale beige background. Each section contains a detailed illustration of a floral arrangement, with variations in the types and styles of flowers. The flowers are depicted in a variety of colors, including shades of pink, yellow, red, blue, and green, with leaves in different tones of green and brown. Some arrangements resemble small trees or shrubs, while others show individual blooms with accompanying stems and foliage. The lines are delicate, and the coloration appears to be applied with watercolor or a similar medium, creating a soft, translucent look. Several clusters include buds or seed pods in addition to open blossoms. There is a faint grid aligning the sections, and the drawing is centered on a slightly larger, unmarked area of paper. The bottom right of the composition includes the handwritten name "MARY BERNIER."
title: Bedspread
